newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Powerwave started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Powerwave started at buy.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Tony Robertson Monday started coverage of Powerwave Technologies Inc with a buy rating based on its position as a high growth, market leader as a maker of equipment for the wireless communications industry.
-- said Powerwave's primary business is the manufacturing of single and multi-carrier linear amplifiers.
-- believes that market will grow to a "multibillion" market by 2000.
-- estimated 1997 earnings at $0.77 per share, rising to $0.93 in 1998.
